research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: D-ID is researching secure generation of avatars and three-dimensional human head reconstruction. In a system and method for enhancing the security of digital avatars, it verifies selfie videos using dynamic challenges and creates an identity log for controlled avatar enrollment. In a system and method for reconstruction of a three-dimensional human head model, it converts two dimensional facial images into detailed three dimensional face models. Together these efforts target secure avatar creation and high fidelity 3D face modeling.

about_short_description.short_description: D-ID is a generative AI company that creates avatars for real-time interactions and video production.

product.name: Creative Reality™ Studio
product.description: A self-service platform for creating AI-generated videos with moving and talking avatars from scripts, images, presentations, documents, and generated portraits.

product.name: Visual AI Agents
product.description: Embeddable, real-time conversational avatars that interact with users, answer questions, perform tasks, trigger workflows, and provide personalized experiences in multiple languages.

product.name: AI Avatars
product.description: Realistic digital humans generated from images or video for avatar-based video production and real-time interactions, with multilingual output and optional voice cloning.

product.name: AI Videos
product.description: Generative video production tools for creating avatar-led, multilingual videos from scripts, presentations, briefs, and documents without conventional filming.

product.name: Agentic Videos
product.description: Interactive videos that combine generated avatar content with AI agents, allowing viewers to ask questions, receive responses, and engage with otherwise passive video material.

product.name: D-ID API
product.description: An API for integrating AI avatar video generation and real-time streaming animation into applications, websites, and software platforms.
